finding.title: Field's label points at an id its input never gets
finding.explanation: Field creates an id for its label's htmlFor, but never passes it to the child input, so the label is not associated and clicking it does nothing.
finding.reasoningSummary: children is rendered as given; nothing clones it with the id.
finding.suggestedFix: Pass the id down: render children as a function of id, or clone the single child with id={id}.
